//: Self-exploration is built on its own AFTER the main build (npm run build runs both). It compiles into ../dist/self-exploration so it travels inside dist/ wherever dist is copied (global install, benchmark docker), and reuses the main build's compiled modules (../dist/explore, ../dist/backup, ../dist/util) via infra.ts. Requires the main build's emitted .d.ts (declaration:true) to be present first.
